title: Magic/Mystic Overview
subtitle: A relic-discovery template with Lens scans, research Index pages, missions, ambience, and map signals.
summary: A mystic-tech and relic-discovery starter that focuses on scanning, research, stability, and artifact safety without Ashfall finale lore.
body:
Find a strange relic, scan it with Lens, unlock Index context, stabilize a fragment, and track the next signal.

First 30 minutes:
- Read the Relic Basics Index page.
- Scan the first relic or evidence object with Lens.
- Open the new research page and follow its safety notes.
- Track a relic signal on HoloMap.

First 2 hours:
- Stabilize a fragment and unlock a second research entry.
- Use SoundCore ambience to signal research states.
- Add more relic entries through datapacks without adding Ashfall story terms.
